headline: SpaceX finally catches a Starship out of orbit, Gane and Harrison both hold their belts at MSG, and GTA 6 is four days out.

upcoming.what: Leonid meteor shower peak; the crescent Moon sets early, so skies are dark after midnight
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S; Anthropic shares due to start trading the same day
Polaris 40, Southampton (Garry Tonon on the card); UFC Doha: Prochazka vs Stirling
F1 Las Vegas GP, lights out in the early hours Irish time (Sat night local)

items.headline: Anthropic IPO set to start trading on Thursday
items.summary: Anthropic's listing is priced at $70-78 a share, a valuation of up to about $1.4 trillion, with trading expected to begin on 19 November. A quiet weekend otherwise for tech news.

items.headline: Nvidia still hasn't hired a search firm to replace Huang
items.summary: Days after Jensen Huang's resignation, Nvidia's board says it has yet to pick a search firm, even as names such as Arm's Rene Haas are floated in reports.

items.headline: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage for the first time
items.summary: Ship 42 flew about 14 orbits, deployed Starlink V3 satellites, then came back through re-entry and was caught by the Starbase tower's arms on Saturday evening. The booster had skipped its own catch and splashed down offshore.

items.headline: Why the ship catch matters
items.summary: Catching the upper stage, not just the booster, is the key step towards a fully reusable Starship, which SpaceX needs for cheap Starlink launches and its Moon lander plans.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, with a slim Moon
items.summary: Sunset is around 16:35 and it's fully dark by about 18:30. A thin crescent Moon sets early in the evening, so skies will be dark if cloud breaks, but there's no confirmed clear-sky forecast yet. Verdict: mixed. Check Met Éireann's evening update. The Leonids peak Tuesday-Wednesday night.

items.headline: GTA 6 countdown: four days to go
items.summary: Rockstar's game is still locked for Thursday 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. No PC date yet. Nothing new on the Witcher, Cyberpunk or Borderlands watchlist overnight.

items.headline: Garry Tonon added to Polaris 40
items.summary: The ONE featherweight veteran returns to jiu-jitsu competition at Polaris 40 in Southampton next Saturday. ADCC US Open results from Austin haven't been published yet.

items.headline: Harrison submits Nunes in round four to retain her title
items.summary: Kayla Harrison ended Amanda Nunes' comeback with a rear-naked choke early in the fourth round at Madison Square Garden. It's Nunes' first fight since retiring, and a big boost to Harrison's case as one of the all-time greats.

items.headline: Gane edges Hokit on the scorecards to keep heavyweight gold
items.summary: Ciryl Gane survived a five-round war with Josh Hokit to win a unanimous decision, 48-47 on all three cards, handing Hokit his first pro loss. No Irish or UK fighters were on the main card.

items.headline: FIA bans Daily Mail F1 journalist after Ferrari row
items.summary: The FIA has confirmed a paddock ban for Jonathan McEvoy following a dispute with Ferrari, and some media have announced a boycott in response.

items.headline: Las Vegas next: why the long straights are deceptive
items.summary: Before next weekend's night race, a look at why low grip, cold temperatures and tyre warm-up make Vegas much harder than its simple layout suggests.
